ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (Panama AML/CFT statute, as amended); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 362 de 1 de julio de 2015 (AML/CFT implementing regulations); Ley No. 129 de 17 de agosto de 2020 (resident agent and registry integrity regime); Ley No. 70 de 31 de enero de 2019 (registry modernization and due diligence powers); Ley No. 254 de 29 de septiembre de 2021 (international fiscal transparency and creation of the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales at the Direccion General de Ingresos, as subsequently regulated); applicable DGI and Registro Publico resolutions governing the sworn beneficial-ownership filing and restricted access protocol.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization route for non-Hague jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent corporate registrar of the shareholder's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization route for non-Hague jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn Declaration of Beneficial Ownership (Declaracion Jurada de Beneficiario Final) for the Panamanian UBO Register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian Notary Public executing before the resident agent and filing with the competent registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization; apostille not required for the Panamanian domestic filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Evidence of physical commercial premises (lease agreement, utility invoice, or warehousing/logistics contract) for the scrap consignment operation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Landlord, public utility, or contracted logistics operator in Panama
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic certification before Panamanian notary where relied upon by banks and customs authorities

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every UBO, director, officer, resident agent counterpart, and intended trade counterparty against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and the Panamanian Financial Analysis Unit (UAF-IFA) domestic designations; PEP identification is required per FATF Recommendations 12 and 27 and Ley 23/2015, with enhanced due diligence (documented source of funds and source of wealth) for foreign PEPs and any PEP-linked interest in the non-ferrous scrap supply chain; adverse media and government-sanction integrity checks are mandatory at onboarding, at each documentary LC issuance, and no less frequently than every 180 days for recurring Swift TT settlement flows.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Publico de Panama (rrp.gob.pa) - Sistema Electronico de Registro y Reserva de Nombre, Seccion Mercantil; official online officer at the Registro Publico portal for name search and pre-incorporation clearance certificates.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory inscriptions and the corporate deed must be drafted in Spanish; the proposed corporate name may use Latin-script letters in any language, but foreign-script names must be transliterated into the Spanish alphabet; only recognized corporate suffixes such as 'S.A.', 'Sociedad Anonima', or substantially equivalent forms are accepted; string similarity, phonetic equivalency, and numeric duplication with existing names are prohibited.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Banca / Financiera / Banca Estatal (requires Superintendencia de Bancos license)
Seguros / Reaseguros / Fianzas (requires Superintendencia de Seguros license)
Fideicomiso / Trust / Fondo de Inversion (requires statutory fiduciary or securities authorization)
Valores / Bolsa / Corredor de Bolsa / Corredor de Valores (requires Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores license)
Republica de Panama / Panama / Municipal / Nacional (implies state affiliation and is restricted)
Gobierno / Presidencia / Ministerio / Autoridad / DGI (misleading public-sector association)
Petroleo / Minas / Hidrocarburos (prior concession or MICI approval required)
Policia / Defensa / Ejercito / Seguridad Nacional (national-security sensitive and categorically restricted)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or counsel must file a written 'Recurso de Apelacion' with the Direccion General Registral of the Registro Publico within five (5) working days of notification; the Director General must issue a reasoned decision within thirty (30) calendar days. Parallel to the appeal, a revised name may be re-submitted with a distinct leading token and without sensitive words. If the registry denies the appeal, counsel may file a 'Recurso de Reconsideracion' within three (3) working days, followed by a contentious-administrative claim ('Demanda Contencioso-Administrativa') before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within two (2) months; practical procedure: obtain prior ministerial authorization for any sensitive token (e.g., MICI, banking or securities regulator) before re-filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for pure registry purposes when the registered agent's professional address is stated as the registered office; however, a virtual office alone is not sufficient for the ISIC 4669 scrap consignment operation, because the customs authority (ANA), the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI), and trade-finance banks expect a physical operating or contracted logistics address for cargo verification, inspections, and site visits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 55-65% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first twelve (12) months of operation, assessed because ISIC 4669 is classified as a Medium_Risk_Enhanced category under bank AML policies and because Panamanian customs, municipal, environmental, and scrap-metal licensing authorities conduct periodic on-site checks of consignment and warehousing premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 (General Corporations Law of Panama), Articles 4, 6, 23, 30, 53 and 64, as amended by Law No. 5 of 2004 and Law No. 11 of 2010; complemented by Executive Decree No. 36 of 2010 and the Regulations of the Registro Público
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección de Personas Jurídicas y Contabilidad
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for a Panama Sociedad Anónima. The corporation may be formed with capital declared in the deed and may issue shares without par value. No escrow account is statutorily mandated; subscribed capital must be represented by issued shares and recorded in the share registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the share subscriptions set forth in the subscription book are accepted and the paid-in capital is deposited in the bank account of the corporation. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be situated at [Panama address], Province of Panama, and [agent firm] is appointed as resident agent pursuant to Law 32 of 1927. RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed President and CEO and [name] is appointed Secretary/Treasurer, each empowered jointly or severally to execute banking documents, commercial agreements and regulatory filings. RESOLVED, that this resolution is effective immediately and the Secretary is instructed to record it in the corporate minute book and provide certified copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección de Personas Jurídicas (Name Search Window or Online Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written request to the Public Registry name search desk or through the online registration system with up to three proposed corporate names in order of preference. Pay the applicable search fee, obtain the Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre confirming availability, and reserve the approved name prior to deed execution.
required_dossiers: Passport or DNI of the requesting incorporator
Formulario de solicitud de reserva de nombre
List of up to three proposed corporate names
Power of attorney if filed through a non-credentialed representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is identical or confusingly similar to a registered name, the Registry issues an observation; the applicant may refile with the next preferred name within five business days without an additional name search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (Notary Public in Private Practice)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Spanish-language articles of incorporation, prepared by a Panamanian attorney, are executed voluntarily by the incorporators before a Panamanian notary public. The notary verifies identity, receives the declaration of share ownership, authorizes the public deed, and issues certified copies known as testimonios for presentation to the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: Corporate name search certificate
Draft Pacto Social y Estatutos
Passport copies and residence information of incorporators
Certificate of engagement of the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a legal or factual discrepancy, the deed is corrected and re-executed by the incorporators. If the notary declines execution, a new notary may be engaged within two business days and the corrected draft re-submitted without registry prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas, with payment at Banco Nacional de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized testimonio of the public deed together with proof of payment of inscription fees and stamp taxes to the Public Registry. The registry examiner performs a legality review, registers the Sociedad Anónima in the corporate register, and issues the inscription certificate and certified copies evidencing legal existence.
required_dossiers: Notarized public deed (testimonio)
Corporate name search certificate
Receipts for registry inscription fee and stamp tax
Power of attorney authorizing post-registration filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar raises formal objections known as razones, the company submits a corrective deed prepared by the notary or files a clarificación. If the rejection persists, a recurso de reconsideración may be filed before the Dirección General del Registro within the statutory window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Municipal Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, and Alcaldía Municipal of the place of operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the RUC application with DGI using the registered corporate certificate, declare the fiscal domicile, and record the primary activity under ISIC 4669. After RUC issuance, present the municipal Aviso de Operación, the commercial/industrial activity permit, and obtain the municipal payment receipt for the operating location.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of the S.A.
Passport of the legal representative
Lease agreement or title deed of the registered office
RUC application form
Municipal zoning and permitted-use certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI identifies an address or activity discrepancy, the rectification is submitted within five days. The municipal Aviso de Operación may be issued provisionally pending final zoning approval, provided the operator submits an additional surety or compliance undertaking where required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Board Resolution and Appointment Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate officers; Registro Público de Panamá and Dirección General de Ingresos for filing of officer changes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the formal board resolution approving share issuance, adopting the registered office, appointing the resident agent and directors, and appointing officers. Record the minutes in the corporate minute book, initial the relevant statutory books, and file the certified minute and officer acceptances with the Public Registry and DGI for legal effect.
required_dossiers: Orphan book or minute book with paginated pages
Share subscription and transfer book
First board resolution text
Acceptance letters of directors, officers and resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects a minute filing for technical error, the board may adopt a ratifying resolution at the next meeting and re-submit without repeating the subscription or share issuance. DGI may accept a corrected officer notification if filed within the cure period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Dirección General de Industrias, in coordination with the Municipalidad de Panamá for local commercial and industrial licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Comercial e Industrial / Aviso de Operación Municipal for Non-Ferrous Scrap Trading and Processing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría II - Estudio de Impacto Ambiental simplificado / Diagnóstico Ambiental for waste valorization and non-ferrous scrap handling facilities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance required with Executive Decree No. 142 of 1995 for industrial wastewater discharge parameters; national air quality standards for particulate matter and volatile organic compounds per COPANIT; Law No. 1 of 2006 for solid and hazardous waste management, including generator registration, storage containment, and chain-of-custody documentation for copper scrap shipments to licensed recycling sites.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification must be obtained from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering building fire-load review, extinguisher placement, and suppression system testing. Structural load inspection and occupancy clearance are issued by the Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal. Occupational health and safety clearance must be secured from the Dirección General de Prevención y Seguridad Industrial of Ministerio de Trabajo (MITRADEL), including workplace floor plans, emergency evacuation signage, and personal protective equipment protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); digital e-service portal: Sede Electrónica DGI (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panama Sociedad Anónima, the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) serves as the sole statutory TIN and VAT ID. To procure it, the company must finalize Public Registry incorporation, maintain a Panama resident agent (registered agent), and file the DGI registration package via Sede Electrónica: certified articles/charter and public deed excerpt, resident-agent consent, notarized identification of directors and legal representative, sworn statement of business address, and declaration of intended economic activity (ISIC 4669). DGI issues a provisional RUC and activates the ITBMS taxpayer file simultaneously. A foreign entity without local incorporation may nevertheless obtain an RUC for withholding or permanent-establishment purposes, but the standard Panama export-trader vehicle is the local S.A.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Panama does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election under domestic law. A Sociedad Anónima is per se a juridical person taxed on Panama-source income only; no pass-through or transparency election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT – ITBMS (Impuesto a las Transferencias de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None – every person habitually effecting taxable transfers of movable goods or rendering taxable services in Panama must register for ITBMS; there is no monetary threshold. A simplified invoicing regime exists for small taxpayers with gross annual turnover up to B/.36,000, but such status does not excuse registration for an export-trading business and cannot be used to zero-rate exported scrap metals.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing applies to all active RUC taxpayers under the DGI 'Facturación Electrónica' program (Res. 201-0625/2020 and subsequent implementing rules). Invoices must be transmitted to the DGI validation platform in near-real time, receive a unique digital authorization code, and be displayed with a QR code. For exports, the electronic invoice is reconciled against the electronic customs export declaration; no physical fiscal stamp is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to tangible movable goods, including shredded non-ferrous scrap and recycled copper wire, sold to a non-resident purchaser, definitively exported from Panamanian customs territory, and documented by a valid customs export declaration. The goods must actually depart Panama within the regulatory window and title/risk must pass outside Panama. Ancillary services directly connected to the export (e.g., international freight and logistics) may also be zero-rated where the effective use and benefit take place outside Panama.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación de Mercancías) accepted by the Panama National Customs Authority
Bill of Lading (or alternative international transport document evidencing physical departure)
Commercial invoice and packing list identifying the recycled copper wire scrap
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank-issued Swift MT103 / payment credit evidence from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and Customs may retroactively deny the zero-rating where export substantiation is incomplete, the goods are not shipped out within the statutory period, or payment is not collected within the 180-day evidentiary window. Reclassification triggers ITBMS at 7% on the gross invoice value, statutory interest from the supply date, and an administrative surcharge of up to 100% of the tax per Código Fiscal penalty rules. False, forged, or anticipatory export declarations constitute customs fraud and smuggling, subject to monetary fines, cancellation or retroactive clawback of input VAT credits and prior export-tax benefits, and criminal sanctions under Panamanian customs laws.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of Panama. The national monetary system is fully dollarized, with the US Dollar as de facto legal tender and the Panamanian Balboa as the nominal accounting unit at a fixed 1:1 parity. Bank licensing, prudential supervision, and systemic oversight are vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP – Superintendency of Banks of Panama). Anti-money laundering supervision and financial-intelligence functions are exercised by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF – Financial Analysis Unit). The Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF – Ministry of Economy and Finance) through its Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI – General Directorate of Revenue) administers tax compliance; the Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as the fiscal agent of the State. There is no Foreign-exchange Administration, no exchange-control authority, and no central-bank intervention mechanism.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Panamanian economy is effectively 100% dollarized and operates under full, unrestricted currency convertibility. There are no capital controls, no current-account or capital-account distinctions, no exchange permits, no import/export FX licensing, and no repatriation restrictions. Profit remittance and dividend distribution do not require central-bank approval; the only practical hurdles are documentary: banks require AML/CFT evidence under Ley 23 de 2015 (FATF-aligned), proof of the beneficial-owner registration at the DGI Beneficial Owner Registry, and compliance with the territorial-source Income Tax rules (ISLR) and the dividend withholding regime under the Código Fiscal. A remitting bank may also insist on a DGI tax-clearance certificate (Paz y Salvo) before executing high-value dividend or capital outflows. Because Panama has no central-bank lender of last resort, USD systemic liquidity depends on the commercial banks' NOSTRO balances held in New York correspondent institutions; nonetheless, capital account convertibility is unrestricted.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender regime, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no timeline within which exporters must repatriate foreign currency. Export receipts may be retained indefinitely in USD-denominated accounts, whether onshore in Panama or offshore, and may be freely applied to foreign supplier payments or domestic disbursements. The only obligations are documentary and fiscal: the exporter must file export declarations with the Dirección General de Aduanas (DGA – General Directorate of Customs) and register export invoices with the DGI for statistical and income-tax purposes; the collecting bank must obtain underlying trade documentation (commercial invoice, bill of lading, customs declaration) to satisfy UAF record-keeping requirements. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0%. Statutory surrender timeline: not applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_note: N/A – fully dollarized jurisdiction with no foreign-exchange surrender obligation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Settlement Account; optional Capital Subscription Escrow ledger for paid-in share capital evidence
Operational Trade Account; dedicated documentary-collection and LC negotiation desk
Operational USD Clearing Account; high-volume wire and trade settlement
Operational Account with commodity-trade financing unit; supplier-payment rail
Operational Account with international correspondent network; trade-finance counter

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banco Nacional de Panamá (State fiscal agent)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Deposit Account for RUC-registered corporations; fiscal-agent services
Operational Account for cross-border entities; enhanced-due-diligence segments
Operational Deposit Account for domestic-linked treasury flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium for primary treasury rails. Panama has no comprehensive EMI licensing regime that would allow an offshore digital EMI or e-money institution to act as a local deposit-taker or operate an independent Panamanian settlement account. A Panamanian S.A. may establish an account with a reputable foreign EMI (EU/UK-licensed) as a peripheral collection channel, but the SBP-regulated banking system remains the only acceptable core clearing rail for this medium-risk commodity profile. Offline EMIs generally cannot issue or confirm documentary letters of credit, cannot execute UCP 600 negotiation, and are frequently constrained by correspondents refusing to clear commodity-scrap flows. Practical assessment: viable for small pre-payments from familiar buyers, not viable as the primary MT103/Documentary-LC rail; the S.A. should designate a Tier-1 Panamanian bank as the treasury counterparty of record.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the cross-border Scrap-Copper-Wire S.A. classification (enhanced medium risk, non-resident-owned, commodity trading), fully remote account opening is not permitted by the major Panamanian banks. At least one director or principal with signing authority must attend an in-person interview at the bank's head office or a Panamanian branch; other remote directors and the ultimate beneficial owner(s) at or above 10% must complete individual video-interview KYC sessions supported by notarized and apostilled identification. Where all directors reside outside Panama, the bank will normally accept a Panamanian registered agent or a General Power of Attorney (Poder General de Administración) holder, provided the attorney-in-fact physically appears and the beneficial owner submits a certified identification package through a recognized foreign notary plus consular legalization or apostille as required under the Hague Convention. The UAF and SBP doctrine under Ley 23 de 2015 requires the financial institution to know the economic substance and settlement pattern of the account; therefore, the physical interview mandate is effectively unavoidable

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque offshore S.A. capital structure with nominee directors and no up-to-date final-beneficiary filing at the DGI Beneficial Owner Registry or Registro Público.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Incorporation, bylaws, and certificate of good standing from the Registro Público de Panamá; RUC (tax ID) certificate; current Beneficial Owner Registry certificate issued by the DGI; sworn declaration of economic substance and operational premises; executed General Power of Attorney; complete shareholder and director register with passports and Apostille-certified identity documents; and a bank reference letter from the home-country bank evidencing the source of wealth of the 10%+ beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Scrap-copper supply-chain red flags: unverified provenance of shredded non-ferrous material, potential illegal extraction, mixed-vendor cash settlement, or absence of environmental/customs permits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-lot chain-of-custody file combining supplier invoices, weighbridge tickets, third-party destruction and sorting certificates, container seal records, DGA export declarations, MICI-issued export license for scrap and waste (Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias), sanitary and radiation inspection certificates, copper-content assay reports (Cu% laboratory certificates), hazardous-materials exemption certificates, and signed supply contracts with each upstream vendor identifying the legal source of the scrap.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction velocity and volumes disproportionate to declared paid-in capital, with high-value flows to/from jurisdictions perceived as high-risk, triggering enhanced transaction monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or CPA-reviewed financial statements for at least two years where available; otherwise a notarized opening statement of financial position; working-capital cash-flow forecast mapped to the copper procurement-to-sale cycle; executed purchase orders and final-sale contracts; shipping and B/L schedule; counterparty KYC files including licenses, passports, and sanctions/adverse-media screening reports; traceable S.W.I.F.T. MT103 capital-injection records with the narrative 'Capital Subscription'; and a formal AML risk self-assessment signed by the appointed Panama-based Compliance Officer (Oficial de Cumplimiento) where the entity qualifies as a reporting subject.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential use of US correspondent clearing for rapid in-and-out wires without documentary linkage to physical copper shipments, suggesting trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A disciplined one-to-one payment-matrix U.S.P. showing each outbound wire matched to a single commercial invoice, bill of lading, customs declaration, and quality certificate; treasury SOPs stating that no third-party-named disbursement occurs without a written assignment or contract; maker-checker authorization records; complete LC or open-account documentation; retained freight-forwarder confirmations; and annual external audit confirmation of the trade-payment trail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection is routed via the US wire-compatible S.W.I.F.T. MT103 from the shareholder's bank through a New York clearing correspondent (JP Morgan, Citibank, Bank of America, or Wells Fargo) to the Panama bank's USD NOSTRO, final-credited to the S.A.'s operational account or an optional Capital Subscription Escrow ledger. Panama does not operate a statutory 'FX purpose-code' system; however, the remittance narrative field must expressly state 'Aporte de capital / Suscripción de acciones – Sociedad Anónima [name], RUC [number]' to permit the receiving bank's compliance team to classify the funds as non-trade equity proceeds. The S.A. must be prepared to submit the board resolution authorizing share issuance, the updated share-registry ledger, DGI Beneficial Owner certificate, RUC certificate, and source-of-funds documentation for capital injections above USD 500,000. Because there are no exchange controls, the injection may be held in USD without conversion, and there is no obligation to channel through Banco Nacional. For escrowed or collateralized trade structures, the bank may ring-fence capital into an escrow sub-account under an Escrow Agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for physical scrap-copper sales is the irrevocable Documentary Letter of Credit (UCP 600), opened by the buyer's bank and confirmed or negotiated by the Panamanian bank via S.W.I.F.T. MT700 issuance/confirmation, MT707 amendments, and MT760 standby support where required. The seller presents the full shipping dossier against the LC: original marine bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of weight, independent laboratory assay for copper content, DGA export declaration, certificate of origin, insurance policy, and radioactive contamination declaration. Upon honored negotiation, the bank credits the exporter by S.W.I.F.T. MT103/MT202 to its operational account. For open-account or cash-against-documents trade, direct S.W.I.F.T. MT103 telegraphic transfer is executed against the same documentary set. USD clearing for all Panama-based settlement occurs through the commercial bank's NOSTRO in the United States via Fedwire/CHIPS; no local FX conversion is required because the USD is the domestic monetary unit. The S.A. should also maintain a supplier-payment routing schedule using MT103 remittances to licensed scrap processors, freight forwarders, inspection agencies, and port authorities, each aligned to an invoice number and customs premises code.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC foreign-exchange forward contracts in USD/EUR, USD/GBP, and USD/CHF with the relationship bank or an international dealer executed under an ISDA Master Agreement or short-form FX master agreement, used exclusively for non-USD invoiced trade settlements.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/CNH or other less-liquid emerging-market currencies to hedge non-USD contract exposure with Chinese or Asian buyers, settled in USD without requiring physical CNY delivery.
Cross-currency swaps in USD/EUR and USD/CNH under the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement for longer-dated receivables or trade-finance matching with tenor up to two years.
European-style FX options and zero-cost collar structures for protection against adverse currency movement on committed non-USD purchase or sale contracts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Personas Jurídicas) - standard USD 300 tier for registered capital up to USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; payment through Banco Nacional de Panamá or Caja de Ahorros
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of each calendar year (Law 254 of 2021); no extension available; USD 400 tier applies if registered capital exceeds USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of USD 200-300 depending on tier; Public Registry blocks certificates of standing (personería) and, after three consecutive unpaid years, may order administrative dissolution and strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Sworn Financial Statement Declaration (Declaración de Estados Financieros - Law 52 of 2016) with notarized signature
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry); payment and control coordinated with the DGI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 105 days after fiscal year-end (April 15 for calendar-year corporations); approx. USD 25 Public Registry inscription tariff applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DGI monthly surcharges plus Registry fines up to USD 500; persistent non-filing across a three-year window triggers suspension of standing certificates and administrative strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation - Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF), standard USD 100 annual maintenance tier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - National Beneficial Ownership Registry (RBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual update within 30 days after the corporate anniversary; any share transfer or control change must be filed within 15 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fines up to USD 10,000 under Law 307 of 2022; Public Registry will not register any corporate act (share transfer, amendment, board change) without the DGI-issued RBF compliance certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Declaration (Declaración Jurada de ISR) - territorial-source basis; zero return applicable to offshore cross-border consignment income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 following the calendar fiscal year; DGI extension to April 30 available with prepayment of estimated tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly surcharge of 10% up to a 30% cap plus statutory interest; late-filing fines of USD 250-500; the zero-return obligation remains mandatory even without Panama-source income

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit by a Panamanian licensed CPA required when annual gross revenue exceeds USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 1,000,000 (Law 52 of 2016); below thresholds, reviewed or compiled financial statements by a licensed accountant are permissible
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (full) or IFRS for SMEs as adopted in Panama; fiscal accounting follows the territorial-source rules of the Código Fiscal

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 254 of 2021 and Law 307 of 2022, the S.A. must maintain a current RBF file identifying every natural person holding at least 10% interest or control; the UBO profile is confirmed annually within 30 days after the corporate anniversary, and any shareholding transfer requires an update within 15 days; the RBF compliance certificate is a mandatory precondition for the Public Registry to register share transfers, amendments, and director changes
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Register of Directors, Officers and Legal Representatives
Minute Book (Libro de Actas y Resoluciones)
UBO / RBF due-diligence file with beneficial ownership declarations

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650 - 1,200 per year for a Panama City resident agent and registered office, including annual franchise tax handling, RBF update logistics, and statutory notice receipt
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,200 - 5,500 for a full statutory audit by a licensed Panamanian CPA firm; USD 900 - 1,700 for review/compilation of unaudited financial statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial sourcing: all foreign-source revenue (offshore consignment commissions) is exempt from Panama CIT. Preferential progressivity: 15% on the first USD 50,000 of taxable income and 20% on the next USD 1,450,000, 25% above USD 1,500,000. A 1.5% alternative calculation on gross taxable revenue (CAIR) applies when higher. The Multinational HQ (SEM) preferential regime (0-5%) is available only upon formal designation; not assumed for this S.A.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 206 (F-206) 'Declaración de Renta' for legal persons. Filed electronically through the DGI portal (T@S / E-DGI). Support returns: Formulario 304 (monthly dividend/withholding), Formulario 473 (transfer pricing declaration), ESR annual report.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, with two mandatory advance payments (June and December) calculated on prior-year taxable income.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a 31 December year-end, final filing is due by 31 March (Art. 703, Código Fiscal). The DGI may authorize a different closing date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC number, legal name, fiscal closing date and economic activity (ISIC 4669) of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the S.A.'s Panamanian RUC; no foreign shareholder personal data is required on the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales, consignment commissions and export-related proceeds arising from purchase/resale and delivery of scrap copper wire where negotiation, custody or title transfer occurs in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the S.A. as taxpayer; direct Panama-source sales by a non-resident are separately taxable and trigger registration obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commission income, handling, tolling and demurrage fees invoiced to foreign consignors for services performed in Panamanian port/customs territory.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident contractors receiving such fees from the S.A. are subject to 12.5% final withholding by the S.A.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offshore consignment resale margins on copper scrap that never touches Panamanian soil, with management and control exercised abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be excluded only if contracts, shipment documents and board minutes prove the extraterritorial sourcing; DGI presumes Panama sourcing when the S.A. negotiates from Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of scrap, international logistics, inspection/weight certificates, bank LC/commission charges and documentary export duties apportioned against Panama-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with purchase orders, Bills of Lading and Swift/LC statements; disallowable costs (fines, personal expenses, non-withheld payments to non-residents) are added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Result after statutory add-backs and prior-year NOL deductions (5-year window), before applying the rate schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for direct non-resident shareholders; NOLs earned by the S.A. cannot be transferred to shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 - Tax determination and CAIR alternative
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply 15%/20%/25% brackets; compute 1.5% CAIR on gross taxable revenue and pay the higher; subtract advance payments made in June/December of the prior period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding at source does not appear on the S.A.'s line 6; do not offset foreign tax credits against Panama CIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for advance payments, any withholding suffered on Panama-source income, and treaty credits allowed by DTA; balance is due by wire transfer at filing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the S.A. claims credits; dividend withholding paid by the S.A. on distributions is a shareholder-level tax, not a credit to the S.A.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the tax due or USD 50-5,000 fixed fine (Law 76 of 2019); late payment: 1.5% per month on the unpaid tax, capped at 30%; failure to file after notice can suspend licences and trigger criminal prosecution for persistent non-compliance.
